title: GibCoins
description: Very small client side mod for hypixel skyblock. Focused on party commands and qol.
body:
GibCoins is a light weight addon for Hypixel Skyblock, mainly intended for having fun in your parties and adding some small qol features.
The mod adds a hand full of party commands (!<command> in party chat), thatll allow new funny moments with your friends. Those commands include:

!gamblekick <player> (requires mod like Odin or NoammAddons or SkyHanni) - works like the !kick command from the mods mentionend, but only has a  33% chance to kick the player, as well as a 15% chance to kick the user.

!kill <player> - a good way to let out your frustration with party members, gives a random response. "Nuked <player>"

!shittercheck <player> - pretty much an 8ball command but only made for asking if someone is good or not. 100% a joke, gives random answers.

!funfact - just random fun facts about the game, probably will get extended in the future.

/coin opens the mods config gui, which lets you toggle all the qol features.

![Config GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a2bc1bfe098cb99e940b881c62f809d18e4749a_0.webp)

Currently the qol includes:
- a Player Hider with a lot of customization options

![Player Hider - config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ee844ff1d153b7888545baf4d8653b2bf8785e5.png)

Normal mode:
![Player Hider - normal mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6f25ab65e64c2470748e392dbd2e5a988a2baa3.png)


Ghost mode:
![Player Hider - ghost mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8c2fb6ef22f2c7b3d99bf6977bcd79244d33401.png)

- a Player Size changer
![Player Size - config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4acf091231f6269d7c22910e01c4028c87d19ee.png)

- InvMeow (Plays a cat sound whenever you proc your invincibility, customizable in volume)
  
- Schizophrenia

![Schizophrenia - config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2462a12e84aa2fbd7584e793e76ed440f944c89.png)

"Jump Scare" is a Skyblock related image flashed for about 1s. Its pretty much an easter egg that i might extend on, dont worry about the name, it wont be very scary.

Id like to not disclose on "The Voices", as its another easter egg feature.
Hint: Pay attention to your chat.


- Diana qol makes dealing with plants in the hub easier. Also disabled dying mob hitboxes, which can help with bph if you're really good.
 
- Leap Frog and Golden Fish CI are features that help with trophy fishing.
 
- Smart Term AC helps you with avoiding Carpal Tunnel Syndrome while not messing up Rend.


Im actively working on more features. Feel free to contact me, if you want to request a feature.
